Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. The intensity is at an all-time high after Florida's grueling "dream breaker" victory over NC State to reach this stage. The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

The penultimate day of World Pickleball League Season 2 heats up at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden with a high-stakes rematch of last year's semifinals between the Hyderabad Superstars and the Bengaluru Jawans. The spotlight shines on a "mouthwatering" women's singles clash between two unbeaten titans, Shawn Mendes and Katerina Stewart, where one historic winning streak is destined to end. From tactical mixed doubles experiments to the high-pressure debut of Eduardo Irizarry, every point is a desperate fight to stay "in the hunt" for a final spot. With commentators on the "edge of their seats" witnessing unbelievable defensive plays and "blistering" side outs, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit.

Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this pivotal collegiate team match features Kennesaw State (KSU) facing off against Virginia Tech. The battle for Texas dominance takes center stage as TCU and the University of Texas clash in the high-stakes 2025 Collegiate National Championship. Witness the racing intensity of the high-pressure "Dreambreaker" format, where rapid-fire rotations and a deafening crowd push both teams to their physical limits. This showdown highlights the elite skills of collegiate pickleball’s finest, featuring precision kitchen play and momentum-shifting timeouts as the Longhorns and Horned Frogs fight for every inch of the court. With a freestyle display of raw athleticism and school spirit, this semifinal and final match-up captures the pure essence of a historic Lone Star State rivalry.
